R1.description: telemetry --by accepts the groupings harness, role,harness and role,harness,model, and every telemetry row carries a harness key read like its role and model (H11)

R2.description: A courier (Controller-run external review) record reports the harness that ran it from its worker_route, so a Codex review reads codex; a record with no route harness reads the worker adapter's name as today (H11)

R3.description: Groups count telemetry unavailable per harness, text and --json output carry the harness, and the output of the existing groupings is unchanged (two existing test assertions move with the row key and the courier correction) (H11)

R4.description: The command guide, the telemetry section of the workers guide and the roadmap describe the harness groupings and the value per kind of job (H11)
